summary.text: Tim Kerner is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 84, which the House page lists as representing Jefferson Parish, and was first elected in 2019. His official House page lists him as Vice Chair of the Retirement Committee and a member of the Appropriations and Natural Resources and Environment committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Kerner's occupation as retired and his education as Fisher High School and the Jefferson Parish Sheriff's Office, and it describes him as a fellow of the LSU Academy of Politics.
It also lists him in the Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
